entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes. This is the worst service I've ever experienced!
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, 'Sarah', you can help me by taking back these awful cycling shoes I bought. They're complete trash!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To best assist you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is that they gave me massive blisters after a single ride! I spent twenty minutes trying to get the cleats set up and they still felt wrong. They're painful and useless. I want a refund, period.

I can certainly understand your frustration; getting blisters from new shoes is a terrible experience. Let me just pull up your order information to see how I can resolve this for you. Can I have your order number or the email address you used?

It's under john.doe@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. If I don't get my money back, I'm lighting you up on every review site and telling my entire cycling club to boycott VeloFit. I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your position, and I don't think a manager will be necessary. I can handle this for you directly. I've found your order, and I see the cycling shoes were delivered 36 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that these shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy. You are well within the window, so I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Really? So you're just... going to give me the refund? No hassle?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Simply package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's... actually what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
